_comment: Copy to .prove-your-tests.json at your repo root and change what you need. Every value is a default, not a rule.

plant_writer.why: plants are the whole proof: use the strongest model you have, at high effort
plant_writer.small_plan_note: on a small plan a cheaper model may write simple, repetitive plants (one per site of a known form); keep the strongest model for escape plants on money, accounts and sign-up

runner.why: prove.py is a plain script; no model reads test output

fixer.why: the window that owns the tests writes the missing tests for survivors
